component_info.name: citysdk_tourism_poi_query
component_info.description: Retrieve Points of Interest from the CitySDK Tourism API using a bounding box or city filter.

schema.description:
Input schema for querying Points of Interest from the CitySDK Tourism API.

Args:
    bbox: Bounding box coordinates to filter POIs geographically
    city: City name to filter POIs by location

bbox.description: Bounding box (e.g., '24.9384,60.1695,24.9500,60.1750') to filter POIs geographically.
bbox.title: Bbox
